ownership.parallel_rule: Each path is relative to its own root. Core never writes the pack root; pack never writes core source, contracts, fixtures or tools. Reviews are read-only.

registry.environment: natural entropy is an environment, not an additional registered item or block

fields.shape: inclusive Chebyshev chunk square centered on the machine chunk
fields.authorized_members: any current member of the owning FTB Teams UUID; ownership does not migrate on team changes
fields.fuel_expiry: only that machine shrinks from expanded to base coverage
fields.removal: remove only the exact machine UUID contribution; preserve overlaps and allow recipe-based reconstruction
fields.unload: persisted coverage remains; no chunk tickets or forced loads
fields.fuel_clock: one server tick per machine while at least one owner-team member is online, including while machine chunk is unloaded; all offline pauses; no wall-clock catch-up
fields.mechanical_offline: Persist enabled state; pause owning-team mechanical hazard execution while the owning team has no online members; no catch-up.

config.explosion_schedule: one combined opportunity per enabled dimension per 1200 server ticks; global budgets across all dimensions and natural/mechanical sources; fair rotation, skip exhausted attempts, no catch-up burst
config.cross_validation: maxStoredFuelTicks >= fuelTicksPerItem; otherwise runtime stays unavailable with diagnostic, never clamps away accepted fuel
config.activation: empty naturalDimensions disables natural entropy everywhere; machinery registration alone never enables hazards

recipes.format: chapter-1.v1 skycore:stone_processing, counted ingredients, ItemStack id/count, 1-2 results, atomic commit
recipes.authority: pack publishes production recipes; core contains no production recipe JSON
recipes.balance: examples are initial defaults; pack may adjust ingredients/counts/durations without changing recipe IDs or paired world-fuel outputs
recipes.recovery: same anti-entropy-machine recipe, no separate free recovery grant; renewable rock-core materials only, no wood/water/FE/living precursor

evidence.trigger: owned workbench committed skycore:entropy/world_fuel with both world_fuel and anti_entropy_stone positive outputs
owned anti-entropy machine atomically deducted a real world_fuel item and increased its remaining fuel ticks

pack_bridge.rule: Read legacy milestones and new evidence independently; unavailable entropy snapshot retains new tasks without blocking legacy synchronization. Task IDs stay pack-owned.

read_api.thread: logical server main thread only; no record creation or chunk loading
methods: static String fieldSnapshotJson(ServerLevel level, BlockPos pos)
static boolean hasEntropyEvidence(ServerPlayer player, String evidenceId)
read_api.null_semantics: runtime/team unavailable, or field chunk unloaded; retain task state and retry; never treat null as empty progress or safety
read_api.old_snapshot: snapshotJson and hasMilestone remain unchanged, old schema_version=1

event.semantics: non-cancellable, after committed state, once per new permanent evidence

initialization.team_source: single online player's actual current FTB Teams UUID
initialization.delivery: place one bound anti-entropy machine at a loaded in-bounds replaceable position, with persistent per-team initialization marker
initialization.idempotency: same team+dimension+position retry succeeds without duplication; different position conflicts; marker survives machine destruction; recovery uses recipe
initialization.before_enable: allowed while naturalDimensions is empty; never implicitly enables a dimension
initialization.skeleton_result: NOT_READY, command result 0; no machine, fuel or progress is granted
initialization.runtime_result: Successful initialization and same-location committed retries return 1; unavailable/invalid/conflicting attempts return 0. Destroyed committed machines are not regranted.

persistence.canonical: world SavedData owns teams, machine records, fuel and evidence; block entities keep ownership+stable machine UUID link; spatial index is derived
persistence.old_progress: skycore_teams.dat remains schema 1; no old milestones deleted, rewritten or inferred as entropy evidence
persistence.missing_new_data: not initialized, no machines/evidence; do not auto-grant or auto-enable
persistence.missing_schema: empty data means new; reject nonempty unversioned data because this is the first format, do not guess a migration
persistence.unknown_newer_version: fail loading with diagnostic, never overwrite/reset; restore full QA/production backup for rollback
persistence.reconciliation: rebuild index from canonical saved records without loading chunks; reconcile loaded block links before hazards; remove missing/replaced exact machine only; pending initialization reconciles same UUID instead of granting twice

compatibility.legacy_world_fuel_task: retain existing world_fuel -> skycore:ch01/minerals_refined task and old progress as legacy proxy; add separate true production/supply tasks, never reuse proxy as evidence
compatibility.primordial_fuel: unchanged processing heat source; not world_fuel
compatibility.ecology: 10/30/60 owner-team online minutes remain the reserved decay rules; the ecology decay executor and climate facilities are still unimplemented, and snapshots report ecology_implemented=false.

player_explosion_policy.warning: During playerWarningTicks, entropy explosions do not directly damage exposed players.
player_explosion_policy.after_warning: Entropy explosion damage and configured periodic exposure damage both apply.
player_explosion_policy.ordinary_explosions: No extra player grace; shelter coverage still filters affected blocks and entities.
